chunks: He attended [the sessions of] Sheikh al-Mufid for approximately five years and remained devoted to him until he passed away — may God have mercy on him — three nights having elapsed from the month of Ramadan, in the year 413.

key_terms.الشَّيْخِ الْمُفِيدِ: Sheikh al-Mufid — the foremost Shia theologian and jurist of his age
key_terms.تُوُفِّيَ: passed away — passive form, lit. 'was taken [by God]'
key_terms.لَازَمَهُ: remained devoted to him — attended continuously as a committed student

ai.seo_question: How long did Shaykh al-Tusi study under Sheikh al-Mufid, and when did al-Mufid die?
ai.summary: This biographical note records that Shaykh al-Tusi attended the scholarly sessions of Sheikh al-Mufid for approximately five years and remained his devoted student until al-Mufid passed away on the third night of Ramadan, 413 AH (1022 CE). It documents the direct scholarly bond between Shaykh al-Tusi (Shaykh al-Ta'ifa) and one of the most eminent Shia theologians and jurists of the classical period.
